name: Group By
description: Group a list of records by a field — orders by customer, tickets by status, expenses by month — as a list of { key, items } for a grouped table, a report section per group, or a per-group total.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const groups = new Map(); for (const it of items || []) { const k = it == null ? '' : it[field]; if (!groups.has(k)) groups.set(k, []); groups.get(k).push(it); } return [...groups].map(([key, list]) => ({ key, items: list })); })() }}"}]
